title: Shenwa language
extract: Shenwa, also spelt Chenoua, is a Zenati Berber language spoken on Mount Chenoua in Algeria, just west of Algiers, and in the provinces of Tipaza and Chlef. The speech of Jebel Chenoua proper is mutually comprehensible with that of the nearby Beni Menacer and Beni Haoua, and they are thus treated as a single language. There are some 76,000 speakers.
